$comment: The verb suite's checks (ui/scripts/verbs.mjs, which `just ui-test` runs beside interactions.mjs): one for each verb here, seat and layout, logged as `verb:<verb>/<seat>/<layout>` and named so to `just ui-test` to run it alone. Each watches moments recorded as fixtures of ui/fixtures.json for each seat: yours, the seat that plays the moment, and theirs, the seat across from it. `moment` is the first, which every verb watched until there were more: a permanent cast, its enters trigger and the tokens it makes (the board combat-declare's Overlord of the Mistmoors), `whole`, in one view, as a seat with nothing to answer gets it, and `cut`, the same play cut into a view at each priority (full-control stops). `more` are the others, each played to its recording's end: `zones`, cards changing zone (the board verbs-zones: draws alone and together, a discard, spells countered, resolved and returned, a creature and a token destroyed, a permanent exiled), and `scry`, a scry of two with one put on the bottom (the board verbs-scry). `watches` names the moments of `more` a verb's check also plays. A verb listed here has a case of its name in verbs.mjs, and a layout an entry of its name in that script's LAYOUTS: the windows it is checked at (a phone's are the phone sizes of ui/shots.json) and what differs in it.
